sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate faithfully encodes the complete direct-static requirement on the authoritative ship owner, uses all six required canonical terms with correct datatypes, prevents empty-string and contradictory-boolean accidental passes, and preserves the applicable-measures boundary without inventing an applicability selector.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Prevent accidental passes: add sh:minLength 1 to voyageLimitAvoidance, environmentalForecastArrangements, informationLimitationMeasures, and requiredEquipmentOperation so empty strings cannot satisfy the required procedure content. Add sh:maxCount 1 to polarWaterOperationalManualRiskProcedureCoverage and environmentalFunctionalityMeasures so contradictory true and false indicator values cannot coexist while sh:hasValue true still passes.
